sources.title: Zetatech/pvt-tiny-224 - AI Model Zoo - BimAnt
sources.snippet: Model description The Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT) is a transformer encoder model (BERT-like) pretrained on ImageNet-1k (also referred to as ILSVRC2012), a dataset comprising 1 million images and 1,000 classes, also at resolution 224x224. Images are presented to the model as a sequence of variable-size patches, which are linearly embedded.
